description: Opaque deep green floor-length noble overdress over a cream underdress, with a low square neckline and fitted bodice. Broad tan-gold Celtic knotwork woven trim outlines the neckline, front vertical strips, cuffs and hem. Elbow-length sleeves join draped green shoulder fabric fastened with two ornate round gold brooches. A wide patterned woven waist belt has a round openwork knot clasp. A rich green-brown fringed shawl lies over both forearms and hangs at the sides, with broad knotwork borders. A little brown closed footwear is visible beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
